name: Spellcaster: Origins - Duel
storyline: The game takes place in the Astral Web — a dimension existing at the junction of pure consciousness and digital reality. Here, information is not just ones and zeros, but living energy. Since ancient times, sages have known: those who can instantly translate thoughts into symbols gain power over the very fabric of reality.
summary:
Spellcaster: Origins is a fast-paced, competitive typing RPG where your keyboard is your most powerful weapon. Step into the astral arena, channel your inner mage, and prove that your fingers are faster than any enchantment.

In Spellcaster, every word you type is a spell. Accuracy and speed are the keys to victory. Cast powerful incantations to damage your foes, but be careful—hesitation leads to failure. If you're too slow, the enemy strikes back!
